title: Pay to keep railroad acquisition race alive
description: Pay to keep railroad acquisition race alive. Railroad and cheap-property opportunities are still live. This scenario separates early tempo, late defense, card timing, and forced-exit pressure.

final_action.public_message: I'll pay the $50 fine and get back on the board.
final_action.private_thought: I have ample cash and own an orange monopoly. Paying $50 now maximizes my chance to collect rent and avoid losing a turn. Rolling for doubles is risky and could delay my progress.

breakdown.message: Leaves a playable reserve after paying.
Chooses movement tempo over passive protection.
Private thought names why exiting matters.
